retrospective_e90.what: the gate law and Q130(n) on E90's six gated draws, aifoundry3; known before this freeze

power.note: tile component and committed offset at each law's expectation, one tile's between-pass SD at E82's dips-removed value on this card

E94-R1.what: the committed tile lies inside the draws' spread: the 95% prediction interval of one more draw
E94-R1.per_rule: PASS if |offset| + m <= PI, FAIL if |offset| - m > PI, else INCONCLUSIVE; offset = D(committed) - mean D(draws), PI = t(0.975, k-1) x s x sqrt(1 + 1/k), s = SD of the draws' pass means, m = t(0.975, df_res) x sqrt(MS_res / n), the committed tile's own repeatability

E94-R2.what: does the committed tile's row need a correction
E94-R2.per_rule: NO CORRECTION if |offset| + hw <= band; CORRECTION if |offset| - hw > 0 and |offset| >= band; else UNRESOLVED; hw = t(0.975, k-1) x sqrt(s^2 / k + MS_res / n), the draw as the unit

E94-R3.what: the gate law's between-draw SD holds in the gated rules
E94-R3.per_rule: PASS if law_gate.sd_card1_w lies inside the tile component's 95% interval, FAIL if outside (two-way)

E94-R4a.what: a float kind with no zeros barely moves with the draw
E94-R4a.rule: pooled tile component: PASS if its 95% upper bound <= x, FAIL if its lower bound > x, else INCONCLUSIVE

E94-R4b.what: int8 barely moves with the draw

E94-R5.what: Q130(n)'s frozen deltas track where a fresh draw lands against the committed tile
E94-R5.rule: PASS if rms <= 0.50 W, rms < rms(no offset) and no draw with predicted |delta| >= 0.30 W is resolved (95%, paired per pass) on the other side of zero; FAIL if rms > 1.00 W, rms >= rms(no offset) or any such draw is; else INCONCLUSIVE

E94-R6.what: the gate law's frozen deltas track where a fresh draw lands against the committed tile
E94-R6.over: the 24 fresh draws of the gated rules
E94-R6.rule: PASS if rms <= 0.30 W and rms < rms(no offset); FAIL if rms > 0.60 W or rms >= rms(no offset); else INCONCLUSIVE

E94-R7.what: inside a kind, does the tile's own statistic say which draw costs more
E94-R7.over: the 18 fresh draws of the float gated rules, each centred on its rule's mean, for each law
E94-R7.rule: PASS if centred residual rms <= 0.6 x centred SD, FAIL if >= centred SD, else INCONCLUSIVE

E94-R8.what: a draw's offset from the committed tile is the same on both cards
E94-R8.rule: rms of offset(card 1) x scale - offset(aifoundry3): PASS if <= 0.30 W, FAIL if > 0.60 W, else INCONCLUSIVE

E94-R9.what: each law's frozen offset of the committed tile from its kind's mean, against the measured offset
E94-R9.rule: for each law, rms over the four gated rules: PASS if <= 0.50 W, FAIL if > 1.00 W, else INCONCLUSIVE. The desk table may speak for a row no card ran only if E94-R6 and this rule both PASS for the gate law

E94-S1.what: the session tie (a check on the session, not on any law)
E94-S1.rule: each cell's D within its band of E82's dips-removed value; a failure means the session moved

not_scored_if: fewer than 2 kept passes in the primary reduction: every rule NOT SCORED. A tile with fewer than 2 kept runs' passes is left out of its rule and named; a rule left with fewer than 3 draws is UNRESOLVED.
